title: Proverbs 15
paragraphs: ¹ A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger. ² The tongue of the wise makes knowledge appealing, but the mouth of the fool gushes foolishness. ³ The eyes of the LORD are everywhere, keeping watch on the wicked and the good. ⁴ A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but a perverse tongue breaks the spirit. ⁵ A fool rejects their father's discipline, but whoever accepts correction shows good sense.

⁶ The house of the righteous holds great treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble. ⁷ The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but the heart of the fool is not in it. ⁸ The LORD detests the sacrifice of the wicked, but the prayer of the upright pleases him. ⁹ The LORD detests the way of the wicked, but he loves the one who pursues righteousness. ¹⁰ Stern discipline awaits anyone who leaves the right path; whoever hates correction will die.

¹¹ Even Death and Destruction are open before the LORD — how much more the hearts of people! ¹² A mocker hates to be corrected and will not consult the wise. ¹³ A joyful heart makes a cheerful face, but a troubled heart breaks the spirit. ¹⁴ The discerning heart seeks knowledge, but the mouth of a fool feeds on foolishness. ¹⁵ For the downtrodden, every day is hard — but a cheerful heart has a continual feast.

¹⁶ Better a little with the fear of the LORD than great wealth with turmoil. ¹⁷ Better a simple meal where there is love than a lavish feast with hatred. ¹⁸ A hot-tempered person stirs up conflict, but whoever is patient calms a quarrel. ¹⁹ The way of the lazy is blocked like a hedge of thorns, but the path of the upright is a clear road. ²⁰ A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish person despises their mother.

²¹ Folly brings joy to those with no sense, but whoever has understanding walks a straight path. ²² Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisors they succeed. ²³ A person finds joy in giving just the right reply — and how good is a timely word! ²⁴ The path of life leads upward for the wise, keeping them from going down to the realm of the dead. ²⁵ The LORD tears down the house of the proud, but he sets the widow's boundary firmly in place.

²⁶ The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but gracious words are pure in his sight. ²⁷ Whoever is greedy for unjust gain brings trouble to their family, but whoever hates bribes will live. ²⁸ The heart of the righteous weighs its answers, but the mouth of the wicked pours out evil. ²⁹ The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous. ³⁰ Bright eyes cheer the heart, and good news refreshes the bones.

³¹ Whoever heeds life-giving correction dwells among the wise. ³² Whoever disregards discipline despises themselves, but the one who accepts correction gains understanding. ³³ Wisdom's instruction is to fear the LORD, and humility comes before honor.
